emotions.name: Wonder
emotions.description: A sense of scale or discovery, without requiring an extraordinary scene.

emotions.name: Tenderness
emotions.description: Gentle attention to a subject; do not infer private relationships.

emotions.name: Compassion
emotions.description: An invitation to care; never invent suffering or personal circumstances.

emotions.name: Outrage
emotions.description: A possible response to a documented situation, never an unverified accusation.
emotions.example: Visible damage in a shared space

emotions.name: Fear
emotions.description: An impression of uncertainty or risk, not a claim that harm occurred.
emotions.example: A narrow path above a steep slope

emotions.name: Disgust
emotions.description: A possible sensory reaction, without demeaning people or groups.
emotions.example: Food waste in a collection area

emotions.name: Desire
emotions.description: Interest in an experience or object, without persuasive messaging.
emotions.example: A shaded terrace prepared for a meal

emotions.name: Nostalgia
emotions.description: Associations with past experiences; do not invent a historical date.
emotions.example: An older interior still in use

emotions.name: Amusement
emotions.description: A playful observation, without ridiculing people.
emotions.example: An unexpected arrangement of everyday objects

emotions.name: Curiosity
emotions.description: An invitation to inspect how something works.
emotions.example: A small mechanism on a workbench

emotions.name: Admiration
emotions.description: Attention to skill or care, without claims of superiority.

emotions.name: Neutrality
emotions.description: Ordinary descriptive observation with no intended emotional emphasis.

topics.name: People and everyday life
topics.description: People in everyday settings, respecting privacy.

topics.name: Food and cooking
topics.description: Ingredients, preparation and meals in context.

topics.name: Travel and landscapes
topics.description: Places and landscapes, including ordinary local environments.

topics.name: Homes and architecture
topics.description: Built spaces and their uses, indoors or outdoors.

topics.name: Fashion, beauty and lifestyle
topics.description: Clothing, personal objects and routines without body judgments.
topics.example: Clothes drying beside an open window

topics.name: Products and consumption
topics.description: Objects, retail and consumption in their setting.
topics.example: Household goods in a small shop

topics.name: Arts and crafts
topics.description: Making and displaying art, whole works in their environment.
topics.example: A framed painting on a studio wall

topics.name: Sports and entertainment
topics.description: Practice, leisure, performances and their spaces.

topics.name: News and current affairs
topics.description: Documented public situations; no invented real events.
topics.example: Maintenance work on a public street

topics.name: Science and technology
topics.description: Tools, observation, systems and work in context.
topics.example: A measuring instrument on a laboratory bench

topics.name: History and archives
topics.description: Historical objects and photographs with documented context.
topics.example: A storage room with labelled archive boxes
